title: Read a GC-aware evaluator skeleton
description: You can distinguish the evaluator's supplied helpers from its missing heap dependency.

steps.description: GCAwareEval keeps a heap reference and an environment of addresses. Its allocation helpers request number and simplified closure records.
get_roots selects integer-valued environment entries. eval_add reads operand records and allocates a new number for their sum.

steps.question: Is MSHeap defined anywhere in this snippet?
steps.answer: No. The smoke test depends on an earlier MSHeap definition.

steps.description: The intended smoke test roots two operands and their sum, removes the operand roots, and requests collection. Those statements depend on creating MSHeap first.
The supplied recording reaches the exception handler with MSHeap undefined. It therefore provides no successful post-collection sum output.
